newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Bernheim Comofi H1 1996 profit slips.
newsitem.headline: Bernheim Comofi H1 1996 profit slips.

text.p: Six months to June 30, 1996 (in millions of Belgian francs unless stated)
NOTE - Bernheim Comofi is a Belgian property company and car park operator with interests in Brussels, Belgium, Budapest, Hungary and Berlin, Germany.
In a statement the company said its first-half results were negatively influenced by the decision to spin off its non-Brussels property into a separately listed real estate fund, Befimmo.
Bernheim said it did not sell any buildings in the first half but did realise a 127 million Belgian franc capital gain on the sale of shares held in Belgian electricity company Electrabel.
The company said its car parks unit managed 90,726 car spaces at June 30, up 5.1 percent on the end of 1995.
